findings.title: Unconsulted preemption at the edge of the act
findings.claim: At the edge of the supplied split mapping, the servants' role also activates preemptive action without consultation: the brothers' capital is altered before they know of it.
findings.mechanism: The focus names the servants as agents of a secret placement that changes the brothers' property, while 12:76 keeps an intentional procedural device visible; the contact adds an intrusive, unannounced side to the otherwise restorative operation.
findings.reader_payoff: The hidden gift can be seen as unilateral intervention as well as provision, making the act's procedural sharpness perceptible.
findings.containment: This is an attributed off-axis activation, not the lexical meaning of the servants' noun and not a claim that they defy Joseph; the ordinary commanded placement remains intact.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus coordinates and later device are supplied, but the packet explicitly marks the split mapping and this branch as exploratory.

findings.title: Goods as an externalized message
findings.claim: The placed goods can also behave like an externalized message: meaning is stored in a container, carried unread, and decoded by recognition at home.
findings.mechanism: The focus baggage carries a deferred sign, the recognition word supplies its later decoding, the nonverbal-sign facet of the speech root lets an object signify by its condition, and the later vessels provide a material/cognitive container parallel.
findings.reader_payoff: The merchandise becomes message-like without ceasing to be merchandise: its silence and delayed recognition explain how an action can arrive through an object.
findings.containment: The focus does not literally name writing or speech; the message and external-memory language is a bounded analogy grounded in baggage, concealed goods, and delayed decoding.

epistemic.reason: The outlier has exact focus and 12:76 traces plus an explicit containment note, but remains a medium-confidence legacy-unbound contextual activation.
